notablePrerequisites:
Scythe of the Wretched attached to Fierce Witchstalker.
You control at least two Foods.
description:
Activate Asmoranomardicadaistinaculdacar by sacrificing two Foods, causing Fierce Witchstalker to deal six damage to itself.
Fierce Witchstalker dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Scythe of the Wretched triggers, returning Fierce Witchstalker from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Scythe of the Wretched to it.
When Fierce Witchstalker enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating two Food tokens.
Repeat.
